case.pattern_description: A shared-device fraud pattern was identified, affecting multiple customers' cards. A single handset profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080) was used across 28 different cards in the same weeks, each time appearing as a new device for a $162.35-$162.35 purchase. This pattern matched four confirmed closed cases that could not be mapped to any known typology. The fraud was detected by tracing the card -> transaction -> device -> card in TigerGraph.

sar.narrative: Customer C04108, holder of card C04108-K2, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-11-18 14:15 and 2016-11-18 14:15, 1 transaction(s) totalling $162.35 were made on the card online from device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' through an anonymous proxy: $162.35 (3467635, 2016-11-18 14:15). The same device profile was used on 27 other customers' cards in the same period (C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04274-K1, C05448-K2, C06031-K2...), most of them behind anonymous proxies and each time as a new device, indicating a common actor. The activity is suspicious because: Case-memory model score 0.396; Device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' was used by 28 cards in a 60-day window around the alert; 28 of them behind an anonymous/hidden proxy and 28 flagged as a New device. 4 closed case(s) on cards that used this profile were confirmed fraud, 4 of them recorded as an undocumented pattern. It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-3008, CC-3902, CC-0562. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placed linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retains the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.
